notes.title: UI Overhaul & Full Gamepad Support Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello gamers![/b]

I've completely overhauled the menu UI, making it more intuitive and visually polished. But that's not all!

[list]
[*] 🎮 Full Gamepad Support – Seamlessly browse menus with full controller integration.
[*] ⚙️ Expanded Customization – More options than ever to tailor the experience to your preferences.
[*] 🌍 Localization Added – Enjoy the game in three different languages for deeper immersion.
[/list]
